title: Job Panel: Pending to Ready
description: FR-1303's scheduled report is genuinely asynchronous — the panel has to show an honest pending state first, then flip to ready only once the CSV is actually generated, never faking an instant download link.
successCondition: Clicking "Generate CSV report" immediately renders a role="status" region showing a Badge with warning tone and text "pending", with no "Download CSV" link present yet; after the background job completes (poll interval 1s, queue delay ~500ms), the same region updates in place to a Badge with success tone and text "ready", and only at that point does a "Download CSV" link appear.
hints: Check for the absence of the download link during the pending phase specifically — a bug that renders the link immediately but disabled would still be wrong per this challenge's success condition.
ReportJobPanel polls every 1 second (POLL_MS) — don't assert "ready" before giving it at least one full poll cycle past the queue delay.
